descriptionByLocale.it:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position Job Title: Regulatory Policy & Intelligence Intern - Asia Pacific Location: Singapore Kallang Avenue About Us : Roche is a global pioneer in pharmaceuticals and diagnostics focused on advancing science to improve people’s lives. The combined strengths of pharmaceuticals and diagnostics under one roof have made Roche the leader in personalised healthcare – a strategy that aims to fit the right treatment to each patient in the best way possible. Roche is the world’s largest biotech company, with truly differentiated medicines in oncology, immunology, infectious diseases, ophthalmology and diseases of the central nervous system. Roche is also the world leader in in vitro diagnostics and tissue-based cancer diagnostics, and a frontrunner in diabetes management. Founded in 1896, Roche continues to search for better ways to prevent, diagnose and treat diseases and make a sustainable contribution to society. The company also aims to improve patient access to medical innovations by working with all relevant stakeholders. Thirty medicines developed by Roche are included in the World Health Organization Model Lists of Essential Medicines, among them life-saving antibiotics, antimalarials and cancer medicines. Roche has been recognised as the Group Leader in sustainability within the Pharmaceuticals, Biotechnology & Life Sciences Industry ten years in a row by the Dow Jones Sustainability Indices (DJSI). At Roche, more than 100,000 people across 100 countries are pushing back the frontiers of healthcare. Working together, we’ve become one of the world’s leading research-focused healthcare groups. Our success is built on innovation, curiosity and diversity. Position Summary : As a Regulatory Policy & Intelligence Intern in APAC region, you will support the team in monitoring and analyzing regulatory developments, assessing the impact on our business operations, and contributing to strategic projects. This role offers the opportunity to gain hands-on experience in a complex and evolving regulatory environment in the healthcare sector. Key Responsibilities:
• Assist in the tracking, analysis, and impact assessment of regulatory policy changes and trends across the Asia Pacific region.
• Participate in the development of advocacy positions and contribute to policy papers, comments, and other documents by collaborating with global experts and country teams.
• Contribute to regulatory policy initiatives on prioritized topics, including key projects, events, and capability building programs.
• Support strategic communication with key stakeholders both internally and externally to enable knowledge sharing and promote the value of proactive policy shaping, including managing various internal communication platforms/tools.
• Engage in special projects and initiatives as assigned. Qualifications:
• Current enrollment in a bachelor’s or master’s program in Public Policy, Law, Political Science, International Relations, Biomedical Engineering, or a related field.
• Interest in regulatory affairs, policy, healthcare, and government relations.
• Strong research, analytical, and critical thinking skills.
• Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
• Self-driven, disciplined, curious, and creative mindset.
• Ability to work independently and collaboratively in a multicultural team. environment with a strong sense of responsibility.
• Proficient in Microsoft Office Suite (Word, Excel, PowerPoint) or Google Suite.
• Language proficiency in English is require
